chunks: Then (a voice) called to her from below: "Grieve not; your Lord has made a rivulet gush forth right below you."

key_terms.أَلاَّ تَحْزَنِي: grieve not / do not be sad

ai.seo_question: What did God provide for Maryam during her childbirth under the palm tree?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (19:24) is often linked to the subsequent command to shake the palm tree, illustrating how divine provision (rizq) manifests through both natural means and miraculous intervention. It underscores the concept of 'Tawakkul' (trust in God) during hardship, where physical sustenance is accompanied by spiritual reassurance, a theme frequently cited in sermons of Imam Ali regarding patience in adversity.
